title: MZ How do I change the location and size of the battle skill/item help window?

posts.author: RPGMakerUser4001
posts.body: What the title says, I'm a javascript noob, but I've been editing my battle HUD by changing the rmmz_windows.js file, and so far its going well, but I can't figure out how to edit the battle item/skill help window without changing the help window of the entire game (which I don't want). Any help?

posts.author: Robro33
posts.body:
RPGMakerUser4001 said:
I'm a javascript noob, but I've been editing my battle HUD by changing the rmmz_windows.js
Click to expand...
you shouldnt be editing those files directly. what you want to do is find what you need in the core files and then make your changes as plugins.
As MZ still gets updates, if you update your project itll wipe out all the changes youve made.
if you need to troubleshoot stuff its easier to do so from a plugin as itll contain only the things youve edited.
Many plugins are made with the core files in their default state as a baseline. changing them can cause plugins added later to break depending on what youve done.
RPGMakerUser4001 said:
I can't figure out how to edit the battle item/skill help window without changing the help window of the entire game (which I don't want). Any help?
Click to expand...
depends on your changes. without knowing what they are, best i can suggest is that instead of changing Window_Help directly, create a new window that inherits from it, make your changes to that one, and then use your new window in place of the default help window within those scenes
